tools.name: vectorize
tools.description: Convert a raster image (PNG, JPG, WebP or GIF, up to 10 MB) into a vector file. Returns a rendered PNG preview of the result and the complete file source as text, ready to save as .svg, .dxf or .eps, with a download link to that file valid 24 hours. Input: image_url, a public http(s) link to the ima

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "vectorize" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Convert a raster image (PNG, JPG, WebP or GIF, up to 10 MB) into a vector file. Returns a rendered PNG preview of the result and the complete file source as text, ready to save as .svg, .dxf or .eps. Input: image_url, a public http(s) link to the image; in ChatGPT, an image attached to the conversat" → after: "Convert a raster image (PNG, JPG, WebP or GIF, up to 10 MB) into a vector file. Returns a rendered PNG preview of the result and the complete file source as text, ready to save as .svg, .dxf or .eps, with a download link to that file valid 24 hours. Input: image_url, a public http(s) link to the ima"

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
